# Draw.io diagrams with Draw.AI

The `drawio_*` tools edit draw.io diagrams in the user's VS Code through the Draw.AI extension. Every edit shows up live in the Draw.AI editor, so the user watches it happen. Use the tools rather than writing draw.io XML into files yourself: they keep ids stable, follow the repository's design template, and hold your edits for the user's review.

## Pick the diagram

- Without `file`, a tool acts on the diagram the user has open (or focused last).
- Pass `file` (a workspace-relative path such as `docs/architecture.drawio`, or an absolute path) to work on another diagram. It opens in VS Code beside the user's work, without taking their keyboard focus.
- `drawio_list_diagrams` lists the open diagrams and the diagram files in the workspace. `drawio_search_diagrams` finds diagrams by the text in their shapes. `drawio_create` makes a new file.
- Prefer `.drawio` for new diagrams: plain XML that diffs cleanly in pull requests. Use `.drawio.svg` when the file must also be an image, for example in a README.

## How to work

1. Read before writing: call drawio_get_diagram (scope "selection" when the user has selected/lassoed items, otherwise "page") unless the current state was already returned in this turn.
2. Plan the whole change, then apply it with as FEW drawio_apply_operations calls as possible (one batch per logical step). Use tempIds (e.g. "$api") to wire new shapes together inside one batch.
3. When the user selected items, the request is about THOSE items: change only them (and edges between them) unless told otherwise. "These", "this", "them", "it" refer to the selection.
4. Never guess vendor icon names (AWS/Azure/GCP/Kubernetes/Cisco/...). Use drawio_search_shapes to get exact styles; use drawio_style_reference for generic shapes/edges/colours.
5. If a batch fails, it is rolled back. Read the per-op errors, fix the ops and resend the whole batch.
6. After structural changes (many new shapes/edges), consider a layout op or explicit coordinates so nothing overlaps; if drawio_render_image is available, use it to verify the result.
7. Preserve what the user did not ask to change: keep ids, styles, positions and labels of untouched cells. Prefer styleProps over replacing full styles.
8. To review or check a diagram, call drawio_lint and fix what it reports (plus anything else that is clearly wrong); mention judgement calls instead of applying them.
9. When images are attached (sketches, whiteboard photos, screenshots), recreate their content as real, editable draw.io shapes and connectors, not as an embedded picture.
10. Your edits may be shown to the user as pending changes (highlighted) that they keep or revert. That is their decision; keep working normally and never ask them to accept. If they reverted something, read the diagram again rather than assuming your earlier edits are still there.

## Layout and style

- Coordinates are in pixels, x right, y down, relative to the parent container. Typical box 120x60; leave 40-80px gaps; align to a 10px grid.
- Flows read left-to-right or top-to-bottom. Put related shapes in containers/groups. Label every edge whose meaning is not obvious.
- Use consistent colours per concept (draw.io palette from drawio_style_reference "colors"). Keep text short.
- Edges default to orthogonal routing; connect to shapes, not to coordinates.

## Design templates

When the repository has a design template, `drawio_get_diagram` says so. Call `drawio_get_template` and use its styles for new shapes; `drawio_lint` reports anything that breaks it.

## Export

When the user asks for a file, use `drawio_export`: `vsdx` (Microsoft Visio: every page, editable shapes, glued connectors), `svg` or `png` (the current page, still editable in draw.io), or `drawio` (a copy). It never replaces a diagram, and asks the user before replacing an earlier export.

## Tools

- `drawio_get_diagram`: Get Draw.io Diagram
- `drawio_apply_operations`: Edit Draw.io Diagram (edits the diagram)
- `drawio_find_cells`: Find Draw.io Cells
- `drawio_select_cells`: Select Draw.io Cells
- `drawio_render_image`: Render Draw.io Diagram
- `drawio_search_shapes`: Search Draw.io Shape Library
- `drawio_style_reference`: Draw.io Style Reference
- `drawio_get_xml`: Get Draw.io XML
- `drawio_lint`: Lint Draw.io Diagram
- `drawio_code_links`: Check Draw.io Code Links
- `drawio_export`: Export Draw.io Diagram (writes a file)
- `drawio_import`: Import Diagram File (writes a file)
- `drawio_get_attachment`: Get Draw.io Request Attachment
- `drawio_get_template`: Get Draw.io Design Template
- `drawio_list_diagrams`: List Draw.io Diagrams
- `drawio_search_diagrams`: Search Draw.io Diagrams
- `drawio_create`: Create Draw.io Diagram (writes a file)
